title: Easy Chicken Piccata
description: This chicken piccata recipe cooks chicken breasts in a buttery white wine sauce with capers and lots of lemon flavor for a family favorite dinner.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Slice chicken breasts horizontally to yield 4 pieces. Place breasts between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound to 1/4-inch thin. Place flour on a plate and dredge each breast on both sides in flour.

Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Put chicken into the skillet and season tops with salt and pepper. Turn when nicely browned, about 4 minutes, and season again. Cook second side until browned, about 4 minutes. Transfer breasts to a plate, reserving skillet drippings.

Add wine and lemon juice to the skillet, stirring to scrape up any browned bits. Simmer to reduce and thicken sauce, about 5 minutes more. Add capers and pour sauce over chicken breasts on the plate. Sprinkle with parsley.

video.description: Briny capers and a tangy lemon sauce top pieces of breaded chicken in this restaurant-quality recipe for chicken piccata. The sauce in this video is so addicting, you'll want to drink it! Serve this simple recipe for an easy weeknight dinner.
